Create a rough horizontal bar chart

Source: R/roughViz.R
roughBarH.Rd

Horizontal variant of [roughBar()] that automatically swaps the axes and expands the left margin when labels are wide.

Usage

roughBarH(
  data,
  labels = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  color = "pink",
  highlight = "pink",
  roughness = 1,
  fillStyle = "hachure",
  fillWeight = NULL,
  strokeWidth = 1,
  bowing = 0,
  simplification = 0.2,
  font = 0,
  margin = NULL,
  axisFontSize = "1rem",
  axisRoughness = 0.5,
  axisStrokeWidth = 0.5,
  innerStrokeWidth = 0,
  padding = 0.1,
  titleAlign = "center",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A `data.frame` (preferred) or named list containing the data to visualise. When supplying a data frame you must also provide the column names in `labels` and `values`. When supplying a list it should already contain `labels` and `values` elements compatible with roughViz.js.

labels

Column name (string) that identifies the x-axis labels when `data` is a data frame.

values

Column name (string) that identifies the numeric values when `data` is a data frame.

title

Optional chart title rendered above the plot.

width

Optional width of the widget; accepts numbers (pixels) or CSS length strings.

height

Optional height of the widget; accepts numbers (pixels) or CSS length strings.

color

Fill colour for the bars.

highlight

Highlight colour used for bar outlines and hover effects.

roughness

Numeric sketchiness factor used by rough.js (`0` for crisp lines, larger values for wobble).

fillStyle

Character string describing the hatch pattern. Common values include `"hachure"`, `"cross-hatch"`, `"zigzag"`, `"dashed"`, `"solid"`, and `"zigzag-line"`.

fillWeight

Thickness of the fill pattern strokes (numeric); `NULL` lets roughViz.js pick a default.

strokeWidth

Width of the bar outlines in pixels.

bowing

Amount of curvature applied to straight lines.

simplification

Numeric tolerance used to simplify curves.

font

Either `0` (Gaegu), `1` (Indie Flower), or the name of a custom font family available in the page.

margin

Named list with entries `top`, `right`, `bottom`, and `left` controlling whitespace around the canvas. Leave `NULL` to rely on sensible defaults that expand automatically for long labels.

axisFontSize

Font size used for axis labels (CSS units or numbers).

axisRoughness

Roughness setting applied to the axes.

axisStrokeWidth

Stroke width for the axes.

innerStrokeWidth

Numeric stroke width for bar interiors.

padding

Space between bars expressed as a proportion of bar width.

titleAlign

Horizontal alignment for the title. One of `"left"`, `"center"`, or `"right"`.

...

Additional named options passed straight through to roughViz.js after validation. Use this to experiment with new features that have not yet been wrapped explicitly.

Value

An `htmlwidget` displaying a horizontal bar chart.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  cars <- transform(mtcars, model = rownames(mtcars))
  roughBarH(
    data = cars,
    labels = "model",
    values = "mpg",
    title = "Fuel economy (mpg)",
    color = "skyblue"
  )
}
